question: Post 1857 revolt, the Peel commission was set up to give on recommendations on ________ reorganisation of British India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**military**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Post 1857 revolt, the Peel commission was set up to give recommendations on the **military** reorganization of British India.
 
• The commission was established to address the weaknesses and failures of the British military forces that were exposed during the revolt.
 
• It focused on restructuring the army, improving the recruitment process, and ensuring better coordination and efficiency within the military ranks.
 
• The recommendations aimed to prevent any future uprisings and to maintain British dominance in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 1857 revolt, also known as the Indian Mutiny or the First War of Independence, was a major, but ultimately unsuccessful, uprising against the British East India Company's rule.
 
• The revolt led to significant changes in British policies and governance in India, including the transfer of power from the East India Company to the British Crown.
 
• The Peel Commission's recommendations were part of broader efforts to stabilize British control and prevent any similar revolts in the future.
